ratingSchedule.note: No single diagnosis-specific diagnostic code is assigned here. Depending on documented residuals, the laryngeal framework may include chronic laryngitis (DC 6516), aphonia (DC 6519), or laryngeal stenosis/airway-obstruction criteria (DC 6520).

reviewNotes: No single condition-specific diagnostic code is assigned in the current schedule; code selection depends on documented voice and airway residuals.
